blocks.goal: Extract static helper fields and methods from the large enum into a dedicated helper class to group cohesive parsing utilities and reduce the size/complexity of TokeniserState.

ops.details:
Create a new class org.jsoup.parser.TokeniserStateHelper and copy the following static members from TokeniserState into it (preserve signatures and visibility as package-private or private static as appropriate):
- static final char nullChar
- static final char[] attributeNameCharsSorted
- static final char[] attributeValueUnquoted
- private static final char replacementChar
- private static final String replacementStr
- private static final char eof
- private static void handleDataEndTag(Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r, TokeniserState elseTransition)
- private static void readRawData(Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r, TokeniserState current, TokeniserState advance)
- private static void readCharRef(Tokeniser t, TokeniserState advance)
- private static void readEndTag(Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r, TokeniserState a, TokeniserState b)
- private static void handleDataDoubleEscapeTag(Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r, TokeniserState primary, TokeniserState fallback)
- private static void readDoctypeInternalSubset(Tokeniser t, CharacterReader r, TokeniserState current)
Place the class in package org.jsoup.parser. Keep references to Tokeniser, CharacterReader, TokeniserState, TokenData, Token, Tokeniser.replacementChar, StringUtil and DocumentType as in the original file.

blocks.goal: Update TokeniserState to delegate to the extracted helper and remove the copied static helper implementations from the enum to reduce its length and group responsibilities.

ops.details:
Replace direct references to the extracted static fields and methods inside TokeniserState with references to the helper class. Specifically:
- Replace uses of nullChar, attributeNameCharsSorted, attributeValueUnquoted, replacementChar, replacementStr, and eof with TokeniserStateHelper.nullChar, TokeniserStateHelper.attributeNameCharsSorted, TokeniserStateHelper.attributeValueUnquoted, TokeniserStateHelper.replacementChar, TokeniserStateHelper.replacementStr, TokeniserStateHelper.eof respectively (match visibility chosen in extraction).
- Replace calls to handleDataEndTag(...), readRawData(...), readCharRef(...), readEndTag(...), handleDataDoubleEscapeTag(...), readDoctypeInternalSubset(...) with TokeniserStateHelper.handleDataEndTag(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readRawData(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readCharRef(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readEndTag(...), TokeniserStateHelper.handleDataDoubleEscapeTag(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readDoctypeInternalSubset(...).
- Remove the original static method and field definitions from TokeniserState after delegation (so only enum cases and abstract read remain). Ensure method visibility and package placement allow access (package-private or public as appropriate).
No changes to public API of Tokeniser or CharacterReader are introduced. Update only internal references within TokeniserState. Because the helper is in the same package, no additional imports are required.

blocks.goal: If desired, introduce a small interface to express the helper contract and allow future dependency inversion (optional low-risk cleanup).

ops.details: Optionally extract an interface TokeniserStateHelperContract (package org.jsoup.parser) declaring the signatures of the helper methods used by TokeniserState (only if future substitution is expected). Then have TokeniserStateHelper implement that interface. This enables later DEPENDENCY_INVERSION or REPLACE_DEPENDENCY steps without changing TokeniserState usage.
